hypotheses.title: Low-Beta Defensive Anomaly Conditioned on Earnings Certainty (model51 + model16)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Exploits the empirical low-beta anomaly within each industry by systematically longing low-beta firms with high earnings predictability and shorting speculative high-beta lottery stocks under pure single-line industry neutralization.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Underperforms during speculative liquidity expansions where junk high-beta equities decouple upward from fundamental cash flows.

hypotheses.title: Beta Surge and Acceleration Reversion (model51 + model16)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Fades acute short-term surges in rolling market beta relative to 1-year baseline on cashflow compounders, capturing liquidity mean-reversion as speculative turbulence normalizes.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails when beta surges accurately anticipate permanent structural increases in operating leverage.

hypotheses.title: Deep Value Quality under Relative Valuation (model16)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Longs fundamentally underpriced firms (high relative valuation derivative) whose earnings streams carry superior certainty and sustainability, systematically avoiding low-quality value traps under industry neutralization.
confounders: Unforeseen regulatory changes in financial accounting
hypotheses.falsification_test: Inverts during growth mania cycles where expensive multiple expansion outperforms fundamental replacement value.
